publisher: Nevada Division of Public and Behavioral Health Child Care Licensing

official_sources.evidence: DPBH directs users to the state licensing search with Child Care Program and Agency selections for licensed facilities.
The DPBH-linked licensure system is the human-facing facility lookup; no supported bulk export or API contract was established.
DPBH identifies its Child Care Licensing Unit as enforcing NRS and NAC Chapter 432A through licensing and inspection.
The historical statewide report separately presents State of Nevada and Washoe County licensed-facility cohorts; it is boundary evidence only, not a current provider roster.

scope.warning: Licensure search presence, facility type, county licensing jurisdiction, inspection, complaint outcome, license status, and current operation are separate assertions.

temporal.limitation: Current search data has no supported machine-readable export, snapshot date, lifecycle vocabulary, refresh contract, or verified statewide jurisdictional denominator; older PDF lists and reports are not current roster evidence.

next_action: Seek publisher-supported center rosters for both DPBH and any separately licensed Washoe County cohort; do not automate the licensure search or reuse historical PDFs as current rows, and reconcile jurisdiction, privacy, status, temporal meaning, reuse, and conservation before admission.
